info.title: Long-Term Memory System Agent API
info.description: Curated LMSS v1 contract for agent-facing memory operations backed by the existing private-alpha API.

post.description: Stores source evidence for later durable memory proposals. This endpoint is retry-safe when callers reuse the same Idempotency-Key with the exact same request body.

get.description: Reads one authorized source event. Missing or unauthorized evidence is returned as not found.

post.description: Asks the Memory Broker whether a candidate should be stored, rejected, routed to review, or treated as session-only. This endpoint is retry-safe when callers reuse the same Idempotency-Key with the exact same request body.

get.description: Returns compact, source-linked context for an agent task. Authorization is applied before ranking and packet construction. Each returned item includes structured explanation fields, source evidence, and suggested review actions; the packet also includes payload-safe exclusion summaries.

post.description: Records useful, stale, wrong, sensitive, over_broad, missing, or legacy noisy context-packet feedback. Callers may send either the original query or a packetId returned by memory.getContext; the API stores a hash instead of raw query text. When query is omitted, packetId must identify a context packet previously returned to the caller so the server can reuse the packet query hash. Item-level feedback must include sourceType and sourceId. Packet-level missing feedback must omit item and source identifiers. This endpoint is append-only and is not currently idempotent.

Returns active authorized memory facts with deterministic claims, source links, confidence, lifecycle state, contradiction summaries, safe exclusion summaries, and policy metadata. This is a read operation and does not use Idempotency-Key.

get.description: Reads one authorized memory fact. Missing or unauthorized memory is returned as not found.

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-Api-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description: API key mapped to a configured principal.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Stable client-generated key for retry-safe durable write operations. Reuse the same key only with the exact same request body.

ScopeType.name: scopeType
ScopeType.description: Optional target scope type. Must be provided with scopeId.

ScopeId.name: scopeId
ScopeId.description: Optional target scope id. Must be provided with scopeType.

Unauthorized.description: Missing API key or invalid authenticated principal.

NotFound.description: Resource was not found or is not accessible.

IdempotencyConflict.description: Idempotency key is still processing, previously failed, or was reused with a different request body.

PayloadTooLarge.description: Request body exceeded the configured idempotency hashing limit.

SemanticRetrievalUnavailable.description: Semantic, hybrid, or context-packet retrieval is not configured.

principalId.description: Optional principal override. When provided, it must match the authenticated principal.

sourceEventId.description: Evidence event id. Durable stored proposals require accessible source evidence.

query.description: Original retrieval query. The server stores only a SHA-256 hash. Omit when packetId is supplied.

packetId.description: Context packet id returned by memory.getContext. Allows feedback without resending raw query text.

itemId.description: Context packet item id returned by memory.getContext. Item-level feedback must also include sourceType and sourceId.

sourceId.description: Required with sourceType for useful, stale, wrong, sensitive, over_broad, and legacy noisy feedback.

RetrievalFeedbackType.description: Preferred product values plus legacy noisy. The API also accepts over-broad and normalizes it to over_broad.
